lines.cn: 为什么他们的伪装“过于完美”呢？

lines.en: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
lines.cn: 一辆古老的公交车停在了干涸的河床旁，一群著名的演员从车上走了下来。

lines.en: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes,
lines.cn: 他戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服。

lines.en: they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
lines.cn: 他们采取了特别的预防措施，以确保没有人能够认出他们来。

lines.en: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
lines.cn: 但他们很快发现，伪装有时候会过于完美（即伪装得过于逼真，反而容易暴露真相）。

lines.en: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
lines.cn: “这是一个非常适合野餐的好地方，”格洛丽亚·格莱姆说道。

lines.en: 'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.
lines.cn: “再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯同意道。

lines.en: 'No newspaper men, no film fans! Why don't we come more often?'
lines.cn: “没有记者，也没有电影迷……我们为什么不多来几次呢？”

lines.en: Meanwhile, two other actors Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves,
lines.cn: 与此同时，另外两位演员——Rockwall Slinger 和 Merlin Greeves——

lines.en: had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
lines.cn: 她把两个装满食物的大篮子搬到了树荫下的一处阴凉处。

lines.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
lines.cn: 当他们都安顿好自己后，一个陌生人出现了。

lines.en: 'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.
lines.cn: “现在，你们所有人都给我滚出去！”他大声喊道。

lines.en: 'I'm sheriff here. Do you see that notice? It says "No Camping"  -- in case you can't read!'
lines.cn: “我是这里的警长。你们看到那个告示了吗？上面写着‘禁止露营’——以防你们看不清楚！”

lines.en: 'don't be too hard on us. I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.'
lines.cn: “别对我们太苛刻了。我是 Rockwall Slinger，这位是 Merlin Greeves。”

lines.en: 'Oh, is it?' said the sheriff with a sneer.
'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam. Now you get out of here fast!'
lines.cn: “好吧，我叫布林克斯利·米尔斯，我的另一个名字是格洛丽亚·格莱姆。现在，你赶紧离开这里！”
